about.title: Building digital experiences that make a difference.
about.introP1: Hi, I'm Nay Ye Lin — a Software Engineering graduate from Mae Fah Luang University with 8 months of enterprise experience. I love building scalable backend services and modern full-stack applications that solve real-world problems.
about.introP2: In the era of AI I'm focused on smart, intuitive products — from SSE-streamed features to LLM-powered developer tools — while improving technically and in soft skills like communication and problem-solving.
about.buildCore: Java, Quarkus, Node.js, Express, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
about.buildPlus: Docker, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Redis, Kafka, Payload CMS
about.buildOutro: I enjoy the full loop — clean responsive UIs, robust APIs, and production deployments.
about.beyondP1: Football and the gym — they keep me focused, disciplined, and team-minded. That energy carries back into how I build software.
about.openToCollab: I'm always open to collaborating on meaningful projects, so feel free to reach out — let's build something great together.
